newsitem.title: USA: Consol Natural Gas exec is named Atmos CEO.
newsitem.headline: Consol Natural Gas exec is named Atmos CEO.

text.p: Consolidated Natural Gas Co said Monday that Robert Best, senior vice president-regulated businesses, will leave CNG to become chairman, president and chief executive officer of Atmos Energy Corp.
For CNG, Best is in charge of four large gas utilities in Ohio, Pennsylvania, West Virginia and Virginia, and of CNG Transmission Corp, an interstate pipeline company.
Effective with his departure, the presidents of those companies will report to George Davidson, CNG chairman and CEO.
No date has been set for Best's departure from CNG.
CNG produces, transports, distributes and markets natural gas and offers energy marketing services throughout North America.
